cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
set(PICO_BOARD pico2 CACHE STRING "")
set(PICO_PLATFORM rp2350-arm-s CACHE STRING "")
set(PICO_NO_PICOTOOL 1 CACHE BOOL "")
include($ENV{PICO_SDK_PATH}/external/pico_sdk_import.cmake)
project(tiny_crypto_pico_resources C CXX ASM)
if(NOT PICO_BOARD STREQUAL "pico2" OR NOT PICO_PLATFORM STREQUAL "rp2350-arm-s")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Resource reports require Pico 2 Cortex-M33")
endif()
if(NOT PICO_SDK_VERSION_STRING STREQUAL "2.3.1")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Resource reports require Pico SDK 2.3.1")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION STREQUAL "12.3.1")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Resource reports require Arm GCC 12.3.Rel1")
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "-Os -DNDEBUG" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "-Os -DNDEBUG" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF)
set(TINY_CRYPTO_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TINY_CRYPTO_BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
pico_sdk_init()
add_subdirectory(../.. crypto)
add_executable(resource_firmware ${TC_MEASUREMENT_SOURCE})
target_link_libraries(resource_firmware PRIVATE tiny_crypto_c pico_stdlib)
target_compile_options(tiny_crypto_c PRIVATE -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
target_link_options(resource_firmware PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(resource_firmware 0)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(resource_firmware 0)
# Leave core 1 idle. The test program doesn't allocate memory or print.
target_compile_definitions(resource_firmware PRIVATE PICO_STACK_SIZE=2048)
